verdict.rationale: Dover documents a public API for adding candidates to jobs, fetching job listings and automating recruiting processes. It also publishes a full machine-readable spec at app.dover.com/docs/api.json, which it explicitly recommends feeding to AI coding tools. The probe 404s were at docs.dover.com paths, not the documented app.dover.com location, so they do not contradict this. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works, documented details on authentication and the breadth of endpoints beyond candidates and jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With the API, you can programmatically add candidates to your jobs, fetch job listings, and automate various recruitment processes.
Use it to generate a client or to give an AI coding tool the exact endpoints and fields.
